description.en: Like StopEventRun, but the player is put back by a warp instead of walking: the player character turns to _roty (30 frames) while the message _txt_id is shown, then the screen fades to black and the character is placed at _pos facing _roty with the stand motion (SetCharaPosAndMotName). The warp is applied (CMND_CHR_WARP_SET) and camera control ends.
Position [x, y, z] to put the player at.

examples.case: A whole event made of it (real usage, from ev45010001.nut)
